answer: Every claim must moor at the jetty by driving one ferrous pile into the seabed: a live strike the beacon orders at random, and the pile must ring back its resonance within seconds — one operator strikes one pile per window, so n clones need n crews answering n strikes at once. Each pile's ring is unique to its forge, so clones hum the same note and expose the fleet. Before release, a stranger tells the claim's fable in open court, a checkable story of one real job; a false fable pulls the pile and sinks the bond. One bad pile collapses the whole section, so fleet loss grows faster than n.
